2607.11508.title: CDFM: Towards a General-Purpose Causal Discovery Foundation Model
2607.11508.paper_summary: Causal discovery, the process of recovering underlying causal structures from observational data, is a fundamental pursuit across scientific disciplines. Over the past decades, numerous algorithms have been developed to tackle this challenge through workflows tailored to the specific causal mechanisms underlying each type of dataset, demonstrating effectiveness across a wide range of applications. However, as the volume and heterogeneity of real-world data continue to grow, this dataset-specific approach inevitably leads to a fragmented, test-driven paradigm that struggles to scale to the demands of modern scientific discovery. To address this, we formulate the Causal Discovery Foundation Model (CDFM) as a unified, general-purpose framework for zero-shot structural inference. To ensure reliable generalization across unknown domains, we first investigate the theoretical boundaries of causal identifiability, revealing the indispensable role of causal prior mechanisms in this process. Building on these insights, we formulate a principled variational framework that treats unknown causal mechanisms as latent variables and mathematically decomposes the intractable marginal likelihood into distinct, tractable learning modules. The variational decomposition provides a conceptual design principle for the architecture design of CDFM, while comprehensive causal knowledge guides the large-scale synthesis of our pretraining data. By pretraining on a massive, highly diverse space of synthetic structural causal models, CDFM successfully internalizes complex statistical asymmetries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDFM consistently outperforms traditional algorithms, driving a paradigm shift toward a general-purpose causal discovery foundation model.
2607.11508.paper_summary_zh: 因果發現，即從觀察數據中恢復潛在因果結構的過程，是各科學領域中的一項基本追求。<lb/>在過去幾十年中，已經開發了許多算法來應對這一挑戰，通過針對每種類型數據集的特定因果機制量身定制的工作流程，展示了在廣泛應用中的有效性。<lb/>然而，隨著現實世界數據的體量和異質性不斷增長，這種特定數據集的方法不可避免地導致了一種支離破碎的、以測試為驅動的範式，難以滿足現代科學發現的需求。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們將因果發現基礎模型（CDFM）制定為一個統一的、通用的零樣本結構推斷框架。<lb/>為了確保在未知領域的可靠泛化，我們首先研究因果可識別性的理論邊界，揭示因果先驗機制在此過程中的不可或缺的角色。<lb/>基於這些見解，我們制定了一個原則性的變分框架，將未知因果機制視為潛在變量，並將難以處理的邊際似然數學分解為不同的、可處理的學習模塊。<lb/>變分分解為CDFM的架構設計提供了一個概念設計原則，而全面的因果知識則指導我們的預訓練數據的大規模合成。<lb/>通過在一個龐大且高度多樣的合成結構因果模型空間中進行預訓練，CDFM成功地內化了複雜的統計不對稱性。<lb/>大量實驗表明，CDFM始終優於傳統算法，推動了向通用因果發現基礎模型的範式轉變。
